title: Lateness of a Reinstatement — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
Reservations and Loyalty desk rule note on how the lateness of a reinstatement acts on the reinstated term of a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers.

**Rule.** The lateness of a reinstatement is the number of calendar days from the credit's expiry date as recorded on the credit to the reinstatement date. The months of the reinstated term, added together, are then treated as follows:
- **more than 30 days** have passed: the summed months are halved and rounded up to a whole month;
- **at least 15 days and no more than 30 days** have passed: the summed months are multiplied by three quarters and rounded down to a whole month;
- **fewer than 15 days** have passed: the summed months are used as they stand.

## Days and treatment

| Calendar days from the recorded expiry date to the reinstatement date | Treatment of the summed months |
|---|---|
| 31 or more | halved, rounded up to a whole month |
| 15 to 30 | three quarters, rounded down to a whole month |
| 0 to 14 | unchanged |

## Worked cases (hypothetical, summed months of 9, expiry date 10 March 2026)

| Reinstatement date | Days late | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 24 March 2026 | 14 | used as it stands | 9 months |
| 25 March 2026 | 15 | 9 multiplied by three quarters is 6.75, rounded down | 6 months |
| 9 April 2026 | 30 | 9 multiplied by three quarters is 6.75, rounded down | 6 months |
| 10 April 2026 | 31 | 9 halved is 4.5, rounded up | 5 months |

With summed months of 8 at 31 days or more, halving gives exactly 4, and 4 months remain.
